architecture.title: Locality, responsiveness and bounded work
architecture.principles: Scalability, Stability Under Load/Graceful Degradation, Minimal Overhead in Synchronization, Minimal Overhead in Context Switching
architecture.evidence: Explain ownership, contention, queue bounds, upstream pressure and cancellation. Use check-async-blocking.sh and targeted runtime tests.

configuration.title: Released configuration meaning
configuration.principles: Manage User-Facing Complexity, Design Complexity and Predictability
configuration.evidence: Name the released fixture and affected setting. Show accepted or rejected input and verify effective values or behavior where needed. A breaking configuration change needs a tested migration and release timing.

live.title: Live add, change and remove
live.evidence: Exercise the affected operation, data delivery and unrelated pipelines. Explain in-place behavior, rejected updates and known limits.

behavior.title: Delivery, semantic fidelity and shutdown
behavior.principles: Configurable Quality of Service, OpenTelemetry Compatibility, Data Processing Pipelines
behavior.evidence: Use direct assertions on payload semantics, delivery, refusal and pending work. Exercise invalid, duplicate or partial inputs where relevant.

performance.title: Performance and continuous benchmarks
performance.principles: Minimal Memory Allocation, Continuous Integration and Continuous Benchmarking
performance.evidence: Compare the same workload on base and candidate or justify bounded cost. Link a running continuous workload for a new component or document the obstacle and alternative.

security.title: Security, privacy and dependency boundaries
security.principles: Security First, Privacy First, Memory Safety
security.evidence: Check new trust boundaries, secret redaction and resource limits. Review inventory, crypto-provider selection and dependency audit where affected.

telemetry.title: Telemetry and operator diagnostics
telemetry.evidence: Verify units, aggregation, labels, cardinality, collisions, redaction and useful diagnostics against the telemetry guides.

design.title: Design, extensibility and portability
design.principles: Modularity, Extensibility and Plugin Architecture, Programmability, Constraints
design.evidence: Explain reuse, ownership, failure modes, supported platforms and deviations. Record operator impact where a design trades one principle for another.

tests.title: Reliable tests and regression learning
tests.evidence: Name the failure, observable assertion and relevant neighboring cases. Control synchronization and inputs, isolate resources, and verify cleanup.
